metadata.voyagerCoverageNote: Horizons Voyager 1 coverage begins 1977-09-05 13:58:36.2005 UTC; first sample 13:59 UTC. Launch before this time must be treated as an illustrative view.
metadata.interpolation: Cubic Hermite between positions using the supplied AU/day velocities; Earth distance from the simultaneous interpolated heliocentric vectors.
metadata.geometricNote: Geometric coordinate separation, not a light-time-corrected radio tracking observation. Positions are reconstructed/predicted ephemerides, not live telemetry.
